description: Award history of a supplier from TED result notices that name it as a winner: total award notices, a dated timeline of the most recent awards with buyer, country, CPV and values as published, buyers and countries served, CPV divisions, values per currency and name variants. Only explicit award results count; no reputation or risk judgement is made. Price: 0.015 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"tenders_get_supplier_history"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/tenders/supplier?name=Siemens&country=PL

name.description: supplier name or part of it (required), e.g. Siemens
